In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], three members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Flight]]&mdash;[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]]&mdash;were sent by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] on a '''mission''' to [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]] to gather information on seldom-used [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], as the Rebels were in search of a new base.

Aboard the [[Space station/Legends|station]], the three Rogues witnessed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] seizing the [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI transport]] ''[[Stellar Manx]]'' and decided to investigate. One of the trio managed to rescue the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter's]] crew, and when the Imperials took their hijacked [[Starship/Legends|ship]] out into [[Realspace/Legends|space]], the same Rogue was able to board it and steer it safely back toward the station.

Although the Rogues were dismayed to learn that a number of the station's outbound trade routes through the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] had been altered by the Empire, they also learned about Imperial plans on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]], which prompted the crew of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to go investigate.
